responses: Hi! I'm your AI Career Assistant. Ask me about resumes, skill gaps, interviews, or placement readiness.

responses: Upload your resume in the 'Resume & ATS' section — I'll extract your skills automatically and score ATS compatibility against your target role. Aim for including exact keywords from the job description, quantified achievements, and a clean single-column layout.

what do i need to learn to become a software engineer

responses: Check the 'Skill Gap Analysis' page — pick your target role and I'll show exactly which technical and soft skills you're missing, plus recommended certifications and projects to close the gap.

patterns: how do i answer tell me about yourself
responses: Try the 'AI Mock Interview' module — you can practice Technical, HR, or Coding rounds and get instant scoring with feedback. Also check 'Coding Tests' to sharpen your problem-solving speed.

patterns: how likely am i to be placed
responses: Head to 'Readiness Prediction' — it runs your profile through the ML model and explains, using SHAP, exactly which factors are helping or hurting your placement chances.
Check 'Job Recommendations' for role matches based on your skills, and 'LinkedIn & GitHub Opportunities' for curated external job and internship links matched to your profile.
Visit 'Learning Portals' for a curated list of MOOC platforms, coding practice sites, and certification providers. Your 'Career Roadmap' page also recommends specific courses for your missing skills.
Log your semester-wise CGPA and attendance under 'Semester Progress' — you'll see a trend chart of your academic improvement over time, which also feeds into your placement readiness score.
You're welcome! Good luck with your placement preparation.
